desc: Derive prefix and suffix arrays where `pref[i]` is the distinct count in `A[1..i]` and `suf[i]` is the distinct count in `A[i..N]`.
Formulate the segment-tree value for each first cut `i` as `pref[i] + distinct(A[i+1..j])` for a fixed second cut `j`.
Prove and implement the range update when extending the middle segment by `A[j]`, based on its previous occurrence.
Implement a Python lazy-propagation range-add/range-maximum segment tree with only valid first cuts queried for each second cut.
Sweep all valid second cuts, combine the maintained best prefix-plus-middle score with `suf[j+1]`, and run both provided sample tests.
